description: Want to be better at marketing in 2026? Post content on social, when it gets a lot more views than normal, slightly edit it and create a call to action and turn it into an ad. #garyvee #socialmedia #marketing
transcript: You want to really believe in how marketing works? Make a great fucking video. Target it properly, get hundreds of thousands of people to see quite a bit of it, and then remarket them for a call to action and watch how many convert. You'll believe in marketing for the rest of your life.
